_note: Keys starting with _ are comments. Put this file in the folder you run the tool from (next to run_verify.bat); it is picked up automatically.
_expected_schemas: Entity set rule: an object found in any of these schemas must exist in all of them.
_entity_set_exclude: Regexes on the file name without schema, e.g. "^ACE_CONFIG_" to skip a group.
_cross_schema_allow: Allowed cross-schema references, e.g. staging migration procs that read dbo tables.
_preexisting_objects: Objects that already exist in PROD: CREATE OR ALTER deploy may roll back with ALTER. Same as a '-- verify:preexisting' comment in the deploy script.
_sqlcmd: Only used with --compile (SET NOEXEC ON: compile only, nothing is executed). Same settings as run_changelog_sql.bat.
